note: Approved 2026-10-05. The model names one design per paper (plus a second strand for mixed methods, or for a report with its own data or model); the design picks the profile and the starting level (rubric.md, 'From answers to a grade').

designs.label: Experiment or quasi-experiment
designs.definition: Assigns a treatment at random or as-if at random, or compares a treated group with a comparison group before and after (difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, natural experiment); Maryland SMS level 3 or higher.

designs.label: Observational quantitative study
designs.definition: Analyses survey, administrative or market data without a comparison design: cross-sections, regressions, descriptive statistics, choice experiments, adoption models.

designs.label: Measured performance (field monitoring)
designs.definition: Reports metered or monitored performance of real equipment, buildings or systems in use.

designs.label: Model or simulation
designs.definition: Results come from an energy, building, techno-economic, system or agent-based model, or from scenarios.

designs.label: Case study
designs.definition: Studies one or a few cases in depth (a city, a programme, a technology, a firm), often over time, from several kinds of evidence; includes process tracing and historical case studies.

designs.label: Interviews, focus groups, ethnography or documents
designs.definition: Primary qualitative data not organised as a case study: interviews, focus groups, workshops, observation, or analysis of documents or media.

designs.label: Mixed methods
designs.definition: Combines a quantitative and a qualitative strand, each reported with its own data. Name both strands.

designs.label: Systematic review or meta-analysis
designs.definition: Reviews a literature with a reported search, inclusion criteria and appraisal or pooling.

designs.label: Narrative or scoping review
designs.definition: Reviews a literature without a reported systematic search; includes scoping, critical and state-of-the-art reviews.

designs.label: Theory or conceptual paper
designs.definition: Develops, adapts or criticises a framework, typology or model by argument, perhaps with illustrative examples.

designs.label: Commentary, editorial or perspective
designs.definition: A short perspective, editorial, viewpoint, encyclopedia entry or research agenda, arguing a position without a study of its own.

designs.label: Report, working paper or thesis
designs.definition: A report, working paper, policy document or thesis not written as a journal study. If it carries its own data or model, name that as the second strand.
